en.askTitle: Swap in your own family, dates and budget and get the same costed London plan
en.runTitle: Toronto to London: four days with two teenagers on about GBP 1,800

fields.label: Travellers, ages, passports and mobility needs
fields.value: Two adults and two teenagers aged 14 and 16, travelling on Canadian passports

fields.label: Dates and actual airports/flight times
fields.value: Arriving Friday morning, 9 July 2027, and leaving Monday evening, 12 July 2027

fields.label: Budget and exclusions
fields.value: About GBP 1,800 for the family, excluding flights

en.template: Plan London for {travellers} on {dates}, within {budget}. Compare rooms with suitable bedding and full family totals; show age-specific transport, stadium and theatre costs, plus free rain alternatives. Cost the Studio Tour as a separate trade-off, not an automatic extra. Separate dated examples from confirmed quotes and flag entry requirements. Plan only: do not book, contact anyone, create accounts or pay.

phases.title: Check official fares, attraction prices, entry rules and family room rates
phases.note: Transport caps, Arsenal and the British Museum, theatre day seats, hotels
phases.judgment: It spotted that the Arsenal stadium-tour page contradicts itself: the ticket table says £36 adult and £26 child, while a banner on the same page says “from £34”. It budgeted with the table (£36 for the 16-year-old, £26 for the 14-year-old) and called it today’s price, not a July 2027 quote.

phases.title: Build the day-by-day plan with a cost table that adds up
phases.judgment: The independent colleague recomputed the £186.90 transport total, the £1,580.90 allocation and the £219.10 reserve, plus both Studio Tour alternatives, and found them correct. It also confirmed that current prices, future prices and hotel “from” rates were kept apart.

phases.title: Check dates, links and desktop and phone layout, then hand over the files
phases.judgment: The hand-over states its limits plainly: hotel prices are advertised “from” rates rather than July quotes, and a few early page reads happened before switching to a fresh browser, which is disclosed.

workers: Found family rooms for four in London and noted the price seen, the date seen and the occupancy rules
Checked current prices and hours for the Arsenal tour and the British Museum, plus free Harry Potter stops and cheap theatre seats
Independently audited the finished plan for sums, calendar dates, scheduling clashes and anything the family asked for that was missing

zh.askTitle: 换成你自己的家庭、日期和预算，拿到同样带费用的伦敦行程
zh.runTitle: 多伦多到伦敦：带两个青少年玩四天，预算约 1,800 英镑

fields.label: 人数、年龄、护照及行动需求
fields.value: 两位大人和两个青少年（14 岁和 16 岁），持加拿大护照

fields.label: 日期和真实机场航班时间
fields.value: 2027 年 7 月 9 日（周五）上午抵达，7 月 12 日（周一）晚上离开

fields.label: 预算及不含项目
fields.value: 全家约 1,800 英镑，不含机票

zh.template: 请按{travellers}、{dates}、{budget}规划伦敦。比较床位合适的房间及全家完整房账，按年龄算交通、球场和演出费用，并安排免费的雨天替代。影城单独算取舍，不自动加项；区分有日期的示例与已确认报价，并提示入境要求。只做规划，不预订、不联系、不开户、不付款。

phases.title: 核对官方票价、景点价格、入境规定和家庭房价
phases.note: 交通封顶、阿森纳和大英博物馆、剧院日场票、酒店
phases.judgment: 它发现阿森纳球场参观页面自相矛盾：票价表写成人 36 英镑、儿童 26 英镑，同一页的横幅却写“34 英镑起”。它按票价表做预算（16 岁按成人 36 英镑，14 岁按儿童 26 英镑），并注明这是当下价格，不是 2027 年 7 月的报价。

phases.title: 做出逐日行程，并列出一张加得起来的费用表
phases.judgment: 独立复核的同事把交通 186.90 英镑、分配 1,580.90 英镑、预留 219.10 英镑，以及两种影城方案都重算了一遍，结果都对。它还确认当前价格、未来价格和酒店“起”的标价被分开标注。

phases.title: 检查日期、链接以及电脑和手机版面，再交付文件
phases.judgment: 交付时把局限讲得很清楚：酒店价格是官网标出的“起”价而不是 7 月报价，另有少量早期页面是在换用新的浏览器之前读取的，这一点也已写明。

workers: 找出伦敦可住四个人的家庭房，并记下看到的价格、看到的日期和入住人数规定
核对阿森纳球场参观和大英博物馆当前的价格与开放时间，另查免费的哈利·波特取景点和便宜的剧院票
独立审查成稿：算术、日期、行程冲突，以及家人要求里有没有漏掉的
